Blockson

One engine, many client sites. A whole site is one content.json plus an image folder; the engine validates it and emits SEO-ready static HTML. Owners maintain their site through a click-to-edit editor whose every write passes a deterministic patch allowlist — unsafe edits are unrepresentable.

Try the click-to-edit editor →

The demo is the real editor running against the fictional Wren & Willow salon, entirely in your browser — no install, no server. Every edit flows through the same validation and patch gate as production; only Publish is disabled.
